rationale: The 7% gap on no identifiable news has already faded ~5% off the high to below both VWAP ($8.34) and the 9-EMA ($8.27), but the last several 1-minute bars show rising lows and sharply drying volume — a mid-range consolidation where neither side currently controls price, making entry timing poor in either direction. Shorting here means chasing a fade that already happened (with squeeze risk on a heavily-traded small-cap gap), while the long requires a VWAP reclaim that hasn't triggered, all against a risk-off tape (SPY -0.76%, VIXY +2.72%) with half the daily loss budget already spent and existing exposure in the same sector. Waiting for either a decisive VWAP reclaim or a breakdown through the 8.11-8.15 shelf offers a cleaner, higher-edge entry.
